headword: {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}

definitions.explanation: News coverage or an interview obtained by a single media outlet with no access granted to competitors. A common selling point on magazine covers and in TV news promotion, signaling that the content cannot be seen or read elsewhere.

examples.japanese: これは{独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}です。
{有名|ゆうめい}な{監督|かんとく}に{独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: We conducted an exclusive interview with the famous director.

examples.japanese: {週刊|しゅうかん}{誌|し}が{事件|じけん}の{当事者|とうじしゃ}への{独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}に{成功|せいこう}し、{話題|わだい}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: The weekly magazine landed an exclusive interview with the person at the center of the incident and drew a lot of attention.

notes:
Compound of {独占|どくせん} ('monopoly; exclusive possession') + {取材|しゅざい} ('news gathering, reporting; interview'). Widely used by newspapers, TV news programs, and weekly magazines to promote content that cannot be found in competing outlets.

Can function grammatically as both a noun and a する verb: {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}する ('to get an exclusive interview').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}に{成功|せいこう}する: to succeed in getting an exclusive
- {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}を{行|おこな}う: to conduct an exclusive interview
- {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}を{受|う}ける: to grant an exclusive interview
- {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}{映像|えいぞう}: exclusive footage
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}: urgent exclusive interview

RELATED TERMS:
- {取材|しゅざい}: news gathering; reporting; interview (the general term)
- {独占|どくせん}: monopoly; exclusive control
- スクープ: scoop — an exclusive story, especially a surprising one
- {独占|どくせん}{放送|ほうそう}: exclusive broadcast
- {独占|どくせん}{配信|はいしん}: exclusive streaming/distribution
- {会見|かいけん}: press conference — contrasts with an exclusive in that many outlets attend

USAGE:
Strongly associated with media and journalism. On magazine covers it often appears as a large headline: 「{独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}!」
